sources.title: guardex-ai · PyPI
sources.snippet: GuardEx: AI Guardrails GuardEx is a Python SDK that screens LLM inputs and outputs for unsafe content, PII, prompt injection, and optional grounding checks. Everything runs in-process, with no external API. It drops in front of any LLM call in about ten lines of code. Apache 2.0. Python 3.10+.
